name: Abenójar (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Abenójar (a castle on red above a cross of Calatrava on white).
history: Municipal flag of Abenójar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Abenójar arms — castle above a cross of Calatrava
